query:
UPDATE admin_users
          SET failed_sign_in_count = CASE
                  WHEN failed_sign_in_count + 1 >= $2 THEN 0
                  ELSE failed_sign_in_count + 1
              END,
              locked_until = CASE
                  WHEN failed_sign_in_count + 1 >= $2 THEN $3
                  ELSE locked_until
              END
          WHERE id = $1
          RETURNING locked_until IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3 AS "locked_now!"
